sprint: Planned Example Completion Gap Analysis and Full-Coverage Generation Design

1_planned_scenario_contract.description: Every planned scenario must declare its requirements upfront, before generation.

fields.required_inputs: List of input file specifications (count, format, creation_lines)
fields.known_invalid_patterns: Patterns the LLM must NOT use (from backlog failures)
fields.few_shot_required: Whether a few-shot code example is needed
fields.few_shot_code: The few-shot code if required (from fixture harness or prior successful run)
fields.completion_blocker: null or description of what blocks this scenario

source_of_data.required_inputs: family config yaml → template_hints + per-type overrides
source_of_data.few_shot_code: fixture-validation harness or prior successful runs

2_scenario_completion_queue.description: Instead of binary pass/exclude, every scenario flows through a state machine.

transitions.contract_defined → blocked_*: one or more requirements not met

2_scenario_completion_queue.implementation: Extend example_lifecycle.py with full state machine. Replace blocked-scenarios.json with scenario-completion-queue.json.

3_learning_repair_system.description: Feed prior failure patterns into future prompts and validators.

backlog_to_prompt.how: At prompt-build time, read backlog entries for the target type. Inject known_invalid_patterns as negative constraints.
backlog_to_prompt.example: For pdf-splitter: 'Do NOT use new PluginOptions(). PluginOptions is abstract. Use new SplitOptions() instead.'

few_shot_from_success.how: After a successful generation, save the validated Program.cs as a few-shot template for the same type in future runs.

validator_rule_from_failure.how: When a failure pattern is identified (e.g., PluginOptions hallucination), add it to _validate_code() as a blocking issue that triggers targeted repair.
validator_rule_from_failure.current_state: _validate_code() has the PluginOptions check but it is informational only. Change to blocking.

repair_context_enrichment.how: Include type-role-classification.paired_options and fixture harness code patterns in repair prompts.
repair_context_enrichment.current_state: Repair prompt only includes compiler error + original code.

4_backlog_to_taskcard_bridge.description: Backlog entries should automatically create or link to taskcards.
4_backlog_to_taskcard_bridge.current_state: Backlog entries have a taskcard_id field but it is manually populated. No automation.
4_backlog_to_taskcard_bridge.proposed: When a scenario enters 'backlogged' state in the completion queue, auto-generate a taskcard entry in open-taskcard-closure-matrix.json with the root cause, affected scenario, and recommended fix.

5_readiness_rank_upgrade.description: Readiness rank should expose full-completion metrics.

new_fields.full_completion_possible: bool — all candidate scenarios have a path to completion
new_fields.next_blocker_to_clear: the single taskcard that unblocks the most scenarios
new_fields.expected_completion_after_fixes: int — how many scenarios would complete if all open taskcards were closed

controlled_pilot.condition: Every excluded scenario has a backlog entry AND a taskcard

full_family_launch.condition: All candidate scenarios must be merged OR permanently excluded with documented waiver

monthly_updates.condition: Every previously merged scenario must still build+run from clean clone. api-delta-report flags breaking changes.
monthly_updates.metric: All prior examples in release-status.json still POST_MERGE_VERIFIED
